concept.title: MC-5000 Safety System Overview
concept.shortdesc: The MC-5000 Vertical Machining Center integrates a three-layer safety architecture that protects operators, equipment, and workpieces during automated and manual operations.

section.title: Safety Architecture
section.p: The MC-5000 safety system follows a three-layer architecture designed to meet ISO 13849-1 (PLr) and ISO 12100 requirements:

dlentry.dd: Interlocked doors, light curtains, emergency stops (E-Stop), and chip guards. These provide the primary barrier between the operator and hazardous motion.
Siemens SINUMERIK ONE safety-integrated PLC with dual-channel redundant I/O. Monitors door status, spindle load, axis positioning, and coolant flow.
Real-time diagnostics, safe speed monitoring, safe torque off (STO), and safe brake control (SBC). All safety functions comply with ISO 13849-1 Category 3 / PLd.

section.title: Regulatory Compliance
section.p: The MC-5000 safety system is certified against the following standards:

ul.li: ISO 12100 — Risk assessment and risk reduction methodology
ISO 13849-1 — Safety-related parts of control systems (Category 3, PLd)
ISO 13855 — Positioning of safeguards with respect to approach speeds
GB/T 15706 — Chinese national standard equivalent (mandatory for domestic sales)
